An SLP who loves your reels has never seen you work through a real case live. The first time they get that is inside a 10-week Academy, which is a big first step.

No first purchase

Curious SLPs can’t say a small yes

The cheapest way to learn from you is a $185 call. Most clinicians who are curious aren’t ready for that yet, so they buy nothing and keep googling.

Waitlist only

Demand rises and falls with each cohort

The Academy opens through a waitlist with cohort dates. Between launches there’s nowhere for interest to go, and no signal of who is ready to enrol.

An SLP who isn’t ready for the Academy today leaves with a free guide at best, and you can’t tell which of your followers are ready to enrol.

Sound familiar?

You care about your clients who stutter. You just want to know what to do next.

  • You’re not sure how to work on fluency shaping and acceptance of stuttering at the same time.
  • You run out of ideas for stuttering sessions and want evidence-based materials.
  • You want a better way to talk about stuttering and progress with kids and their parents.
  • You’re new to stuttering, or experienced and stuck with a current client.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Where to start with a new stuttering client

Setting the stage: the questions to ask first, so every goal has a clear why behind it.

Fluency shaping and acceptance, without the confusion

How to address the physical and the affective side in the same plan, through a stutter-affirming lens.

Session ideas for every age

Activities you can use with preschool, school-age and teen clients when you feel out of ideas.

How to talk about progress with kids and parents

Simple language for explaining what therapy is working on and what progress looks like.

What to do when you feel stuck

A way to step back, re-check your plan and choose the next move with a current client.

Meet Victoria

Hi, I’m Victoria Dertouzos

I’m a speech-language pathologist (M.A., CCC-SLP) and I’ve been practising for almost a decade. I own Speech & Stuttering Therapy of New Jersey, and since 2020 I’ve completed over 100 hours of stuttering continuing education. I also host the summer programme Camp Dream. Speak. Live.

In my Stuttering Therapy Academy I take SLPs through three pillars:

Setting the Stage: The WhyIntuitive Therapy for the PhysicalLasting Therapy for the Affective

This masterclass is where that work starts.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Who is this for?

SLPs who work with people who stutter, or want to. It suits clinicians new to stuttering and experienced clinicians who feel stuck with a client.

What if I can’t make it live?

Your seat includes the replay, so you can watch it when it suits you.

Does this count towards CEUs?

[Confirm CEU status. If the class isn’t registered with an approved provider: this is a professional development class and is not offered for ASHA CEUs.]

Will you tell me what to do with my specific client?

This is educational content for clinicians, not medical advice. You’ll leave with frameworks and ideas, and you keep using your own clinical judgement for each client.

Why is it only $17?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, take what you need for your caseload, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Educational content for speech-language pathologists, not medical advice.

3 things to think about before we talk
Preview
So we spend the call on your caseload, not on small talk.

Hi [first name],

Before our call, take five minutes with these:

1. How many clients who stutter are on your caseload, and what ages?
2. Where do you feel least sure: evaluation, the physical side, the affective side, or talking with parents?
3. What would feel different if you walked into those sessions confident?

No need to send me the answers. Just bring them with you.

Victoria

Ad creatives · Video scripts

Ad scripts for the masterclass

Script 1 · “Stop googling”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If you’ve ever googled ‘stuttering therapy activities’ the night before a session, this is for you.”

Body

“Without a plan, it’s easy to search, guess and hope it helps. There’s a better way: a simple plan that starts with the why, then works on both the physical and the affective side.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass for SLPs. It’s $17, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera in your therapy room. On-screen text: “Stop googling. Start planning.” Caption ends: Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 2 · “Both, not either”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Fluency shaping or acceptance? Here’s why it doesn’t have to be one or the other.”

Body

“A lot of SLPs feel stuck choosing between techniques and acceptance. A stutter-affirming plan can make room for both, so you’re working on what feels physically hard and how speaking feels, in the same session.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in Stop Guessing in Stuttering Therapy. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, split-screen text “physical” and “affective”, the word “both” highlighted.

Script 3 · “The parent conversation”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What do you say when a parent asks, ‘Is therapy working?’”

Body

“Progress in stuttering therapy isn’t only about how often someone stutters. It’s also about confidence, participation and how speaking feels. When you can explain that clearly, parents become partners in the plan.”

CTA

“I’ll give you the words in my live masterclass for SLPs. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slide with three “progress” examples. Caption ends: Educational content, not medical advice.
